sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can build the future tense with fog and a plain infinitive, for all six persons.
I can tell a fixed plan (present tense) from a prediction or promise (fog + infinitive).
I can say what I'm planning to do using tervez + infinitive, and choose between tervez, fog, and gondolkodik.
I can ask what someone will do, and say what I won't do, with fog + infinitive.
I can use majd to point loosely at a later time.
